specName: Constitution card and stale documents on the Copilot board
request:
Issue #1033, part 3: constitution card and stale documents on the Copilot board. The PR body says `Part of #1033`.

Settled scope: move the pure part of VS Code's staleness check (apps/vscode/src/features/spec-viewer/staleness.ts: a document older than the one it derives from — plan older than spec, tasks older than plan) into packages/viewer/src/core as a pure function over {type, exists, mtime} documents, keep a thin VS Code wrapper that reads file times (behaviour unchanged, tests still pass), and bundle the core function into the canvas's vendor/viewer-core.mjs. On the Copilot board: (1) a constitution card in the board header area showing whether .specify/memory/constitution.md exists and is filled in (not the template; reuse the same placeholder test VS Code's detector uses), when it last changed, and a "Run constitution" action when missing or still a template; (2) a stale mark on a spec whose plan is older than its spec or tasks older than its plan, shown on the spec detail (the document tab) with a line saying which document is behind. Repository text reaches the page as text. Update canvas tests, `npm run canvas:build` + `npm run mod:build`, a speckit-viewer changeset, apps/copilot-canvas/CHANGELOG.md, and docs copilot-app/index.mdx. No version bump.
